notablePrerequisites: Cathodion does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the second Cathodion trigger, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a counter from Carrion Feeder and removing both counters from Cathodion, causing you to mill three cards and allowing you to return a permanent card with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
